title: Boy Holding Horse Reins outside Home, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white deckle-edged snapshot from the early 1950s depicting a young boy wearing a striped crew-neck t-shirt and cuffed jeans holding the reins of a dappled horse in a grassy yard beside a house with climbing vines. The back features mounting corner adhesive residue and a stamped number 451.
